text: {"lessons":["I should avoid selling just to lock in gains; I need to weigh each stock’s prospects and my overall plan, not just whether I’m ahead of my average cost.","A loss in account value can happen even when I make no trades, so I should judge my decisions over time rather than react to a single month.","I should review my holdings periodically and set clear reasons for buying or selling, instead of letting reluctance to admit a mistake or the pleasure of taking a gain drive my choices."]}
